# Efficio

> Efficio is a fractional AI CTO for any business, built for small and mid-size, owner-led businesses in the US.

Efficio connects all the apps a business runs on to one live CEO dashboard, puts AI agents and custom automations to work across them, and builds whatever else the business needs. Brady, the founder, is the CTO who designs, builds and runs it, inside the client's own Efficio account at app.efficio.tech. Every plan starts with the front office agents (an AI receptionist for forwarded calls, website chat, booking and reminders, review requests) and adds custom AI agents (quoting, intake, triage, billing follow-up), integrations and ongoing engineering. It fits owner-led businesses with about 5-50 staff, 50+ calls or leads a month and jobs worth $500+. Plans, each month-to-month with 30 days' notice and a one-time $500 setup: AI Operator $1,500/mo, Founding CTO $2,500/mo, Full Custom CTO $3,500/mo. US only. Contact: brady@efficio.tech.
